short: The primordial matter of cosmological theories.
note: A name for the original substance from which matter and the elements were thought to develop, ultimately related to Greek hylē, matter.

short: A hypothetical particle carrying one magnetic pole.
note: A hypothetical particle with an isolated magnetic charge, equivalent to a north or south pole alone. Ordinary magnets always have both poles.

short: An American physicist and science-fiction writer.
note: John G. Cramer, an American physicist at the University of Washington, known for research on nuclear physics and the foundations of quantum mechanics, and for his science writing and fiction.

sources.label: John G. Cramer · University of Washington

short: A hypothetical sorter of fast and slow molecules.
note: James Clerk Maxwell’s thought experiment imagines a being sorting molecules by speed, separating hot from cold to challenge the statistical meaning of the second law of thermodynamics.

sources.label: American Physical Society · Maxwell and His Demon

short: From German Gastprofessor, a visiting professor.
note: Built from the German Gastprofessor: a professor employed temporarily as a guest at another university.

short: A research journal devoted to nuclear physics.
note: An American Physical Society journal established in 1970, publishing experimental and theoretical research in nuclear physics.

sources.label: American Physical Society · About Physical Review C
